mapper.sql: FROM duplicate_review_decision d LEFT JOIN person_identity evidence_person ON evidence_person.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND evidence_person.id = d.evidence_person_identity_id LEFT JOIN company_identity evidence_company ON evidence_company.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND evidence_company.id = d.evidence_company_identity_id LEFT JOIN person evidence_person_record ON evidence_person_record.workspace_id = evidence_person.workspace_id AND evidence_person_record.id = evidence_person.person_id AND evidence_person_record.archived_at IS NULL AND evidence_person_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND evidence_person_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company evidence_company_record ON evidence_company_record.workspace_id = evidence_company.workspace_id AND evidence_company_record.id = evidence_company.company_id AND evidence_company_record.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN person low_person ON low_person.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND low_person.id = d.low_person_id AND low_person.archived_at IS NULL AND low_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND low_person.provision_ceased_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN person high_person ON high_person.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND high_person.id = d.high_person_id AND high_person.archived_at IS NULL AND high_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND high_person.provision_ceased_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company low_person_company ON low_person_company.id = low_person.company_id AND ( low_person_company.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_share low_company_share JOIN workspace vws ON vws.id = low_company_share.workspace_id JOIN workspace ows ON ows.id = low_person_company.workspace_id AND ows.org_id = vws.org_id WHERE low_company_share.company_id = low_person_company.id AND low_company_share.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) ) AND low_person_company.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company high_person_company ON high_person_company.id = high_person.company_id AND ( high_person_company.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_share high_company_share JOIN workspace vws ON vws.id = high_company_share.workspace_id JOIN workspace ows ON ows.id = high_person_company.workspace_id AND ows.org_id = vws.org_id WHERE high_company_share.company_id = high_person_company.id AND high_company_share.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) ) AND high_person_company.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company low_company ON low_company.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND low_company.id = d.low_company_id AND low_company.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company high_company ON high_company.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND high_company.id = d.high_company_id AND high_company.archived_at IS NULL

d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.is_current = TRUE AND ( (d.record_type = 'person' AND evidence_person.id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_person.superseded_at IS NULL AND evidence_person_record.id IS NOT NULL) OR (d.record_type = 'company' AND evidence_company.id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_company.superseded_at IS NULL AND evidence_company_record.id IS NOT NULL) ) AND ( (d.oversized_marker = 1 AND d.collision_size > #{maximumPairGroupSize}) OR (d.record_type = 'person' AND d.oversized_marker IS NULL AND low_person.id IS NOT NULL AND high_person.id IS NOT NULL) OR (d.record_type = 'company' AND d.oversized_marker IS NULL AND low_company.id IS NOT NULL AND high_company.id IS NOT NULL) )

d.id, CASE WHEN d.oversized_marker = 1 THEN 'oversized_group' ELSE 'pair' END AS item_type, d.record_type, d.kind, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN d.low_person_id ELSE d.low_company_id END AS low_record_id, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN low_person.name ELSE low_company.name END AS low_name, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN low_person_company.name ELSE NULL END AS low_company_name, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN low_person.owner_id ELSE low_company.owner_id END AS low_owner_id, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN low_person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ELSE low_company.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} END AS low_owned_by_active_workspace, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN d.high_person_id ELSE d.high_company_id END AS high_record_id, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN high_person.name ELSE high_company.name END AS high_name, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN high_person_company.name ELSE NULL END AS high_company_name, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN high_person.owner_id ELSE high_company.owner_id END AS high_owner_id, CASE WHEN d.record_type = 'person' THEN high_person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ELSE high_company.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} END AS high_owned_by_active_workspace, d.collision_size, d.detected_at, d.state, d.evidence_fingerprint, d.dismissed_at, d.dismissed_by_user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE duplicate_review_decision SET is_current = FALSE WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND is_current = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO duplicate_review_decision ( workspace_id, record_type, kind, evidence_fingerprint, low_person_id, high_person_id, evidence_person_identity_id, collision_size, state, is_current, detected_at) SELECT #{workspaceId}, 'person', #{kind}, #{evidenceFingerprint}, low_identity.person_id, high_identity.person_id, low_identity.id, group_state.collision_size, 'open', TRUE, #{detectedAt} FROM person_identity low_identity JOIN identity_collision low_collision ON low_collision.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND low_collision.person_identity_id = low_identity.id JOIN person low_record ON low_record.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND low_record.id = low_identity.person_id AND low_record.archived_at IS NULL AND low_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND low_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL JOIN person_identity high_identity ON high_identity.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND high_identity.kind = low_identity.kind AND high_identity.normalized_value = low_identity.normalized_value AND high_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND high_identity.person_id > low_identity.person_id JOIN identity_collision high_collision ON high_collision.workspace_id = high_identity.workspace_id AND high_collision.person_identity_id = high_identity.id JOIN person high_record ON high_record.workspace_id = high_identity.workspace_id AND high_record.id = high_identity.person_id AND high_record.archived_at IS NULL AND high_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND high_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS collision_size FROM person_identity counted_identity JOIN identity_collision counted_collision ON counted_collision.workspace_id = counted_identity.workspace_id AND counted_collision.person_identity_id = counted_identity.id JOIN person counted_record ON counted_record.workspace_id = counted_identity.workspace_id AND counted_record.id = counted_identity.person_id AND counted_record.archived_at IS NULL AND counted_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND counted_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL WHERE counted_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND counted_identity.kind = #{kind} AND counted_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND counted_identity.superseded_at IS NULL ) group_state WHERE low_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND low_identity.kind = #{kind} AND low_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND low_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND group_state.collision_size BETWEEN 2 AND #{maximumPairGroupSize} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_person_identity_id = VALUES(evidence_person_identity_id), collision_size = VALUES(collision_size), is_current = TRUE

INSERT INTO duplicate_review_decision ( workspace_id, record_type, kind, evidence_fingerprint, evidence_person_identity_id, oversized_marker, collision_size, state, is_current, detected_at) SELECT #{workspaceId}, 'person', #{kind}, #{evidenceFingerprint}, MIN(person_identity.id), 1, COUNT(*), 'open', TRUE, #{detectedAt} FROM person_identity JOIN identity_collision ON identity_collision.workspace_id = person_identity.workspace_id AND identity_collision.person_identity_id = person_identity.id JOIN person person_record ON person_record.workspace_id = person_identity.workspace_id AND person_record.id = person_identity.person_id AND person_record.archived_at IS NULL AND person_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND person_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL WHERE person_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_identity.kind = #{kind} AND person_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND person_identity.superseded_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > #{maximumPairGroupSize} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_person_identity_id = VALUES(evidence_person_identity_id), collision_size = VALUES(collision_size), is_current = TRUE

INSERT INTO duplicate_review_decision ( workspace_id, record_type, kind, evidence_fingerprint, low_company_id, high_company_id, evidence_company_identity_id, collision_size, state, is_current, detected_at) SELECT #{workspaceId}, 'company', #{kind}, #{evidenceFingerprint}, low_identity.company_id, high_identity.company_id, low_identity.id, group_state.collision_size, 'open', TRUE, #{detectedAt} FROM company_identity low_identity JOIN identity_collision low_collision ON low_collision.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND low_collision.company_identity_id = low_identity.id JOIN company low_record ON low_record.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND low_record.id = low_identity.company_id AND low_record.archived_at IS NULL JOIN company_identity high_identity ON high_identity.workspace_id = low_identity.workspace_id AND high_identity.kind = low_identity.kind AND high_identity.normalized_value = low_identity.normalized_value AND high_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND high_identity.company_id > low_identity.company_id JOIN identity_collision high_collision ON high_collision.workspace_id = high_identity.workspace_id AND high_collision.company_identity_id = high_identity.id JOIN company high_record ON high_record.workspace_id = high_identity.workspace_id AND high_record.id = high_identity.company_id AND high_record.archived_at IS NULL CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS collision_size FROM company_identity counted_identity JOIN identity_collision counted_collision ON counted_collision.workspace_id = counted_identity.workspace_id AND counted_collision.company_identity_id = counted_identity.id JOIN company counted_record ON counted_record.workspace_id = counted_identity.workspace_id AND counted_record.id = counted_identity.company_id AND counted_record.archived_at IS NULL WHERE counted_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND counted_identity.kind = #{kind} AND counted_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND counted_identity.superseded_at IS NULL ) group_state WHERE low_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND low_identity.kind = #{kind} AND low_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND low_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND group_state.collision_size BETWEEN 2 AND #{maximumPairGroupSize} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_company_identity_id = VALUES(evidence_company_identity_id), collision_size = VALUES(collision_size), is_current = TRUE

INSERT INTO duplicate_review_decision ( workspace_id, record_type, kind, evidence_fingerprint, evidence_company_identity_id, oversized_marker, collision_size, state, is_current, detected_at) SELECT #{workspaceId}, 'company', #{kind}, #{evidenceFingerprint}, MIN(company_identity.id), 1, COUNT(*), 'open', TRUE, #{detectedAt} FROM company_identity JOIN identity_collision ON identity_collision.workspace_id = company_identity.workspace_id AND identity_collision.company_identity_id = company_identity.id JOIN company company_record ON company_record.workspace_id = company_identity.workspace_id AND company_record.id = company_identity.company_id AND company_record.archived_at IS NULL WHERE company_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND company_identity.kind = #{kind} AND company_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND company_identity.superseded_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > #{maximumPairGroupSize} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_company_identity_id = VALUES(evidence_company_identity_id), collision_size = VALUES(collision_size), is_current = TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(3000) */
WHERE ORDER BY d.detected_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE duplicate_review_decision SET state = 'open', dismissed_at = NULL, dismissed_by_user_id = NULL, dismissal_note = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND is_current = TRUE AND state = 'dismissed'
